items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And so he stood behind me one night. And so I knew he was behind me so I did my best. So he said boy how did you play that?

ctx.x: Huh? You started becoming a professional musician.

Yeah well the guys would call me Ham. You see when they think you didn't play so well they call you Ham. Yeah right. And so I was determined to make some of those guys eat the woods which I did. When I went up in, when I traveled in Wisconsin and Michigan and Minnesota, I studied hard. And then I got another teacher in Milwaukee as I foreseed. And so I was surprised with a fellow drum motor named Harry Swift, he was Charles Ellick's band, the Wisconsin Roof. That's before Simeon had it. I was still with Eli…
